subject: executor: fix incorrect result when hash agg spill is triggered (#55322)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for executor hash agg spill restore. Change routes spill-restore merging through `FinalAggFuncs.MergePartialResult` (instead of partial funcs) and adds a length guard in `newSpillHelper`, fixing incorrect aggregation for funcs whose partial implementations don’t define merge (e.g., COUNT/AVG final-phase semantics). Also fixes COUNT spill deserialization (pointer vs value copy bug) and adds spill serialize/deserialize support for `maxMin4Time`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; later history shows unrelated follow-up fixes (tests/races, tmp spill cleanup, metrics), not indicating a surviving correctness risk from this commit.
